newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen stocks spring to higher end on rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen stocks spring to higher end on rebound.

text.p: Shenzhen's share indices ended sharply higher on Monday due to a rebound after recent government anti-speculation measures caused sharp losses, analysts said.
The foreign currency B share index jumped 7.18 points or 4.69 percent to end at 160.26 on turnover of HK$93.2 million against Friday's HK$61.2 million.
The domestic A share index leaped 22.61 points or 5.09 percent to 466.52 on turnover of 8.2 billion yuan, compared with 5.4 billion on Friday.
